facts.fact: Contractor CITCC signed commercial contract NITA-U/SUPLS/21-22/0001 on 2022-04-22 for Phase V: 3,604 km of backbone with 51 backbone sites, plus last mile to 800 government sites.
facts.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure Phase V

facts.fact: NITA-U says President Museveni launched Phase V in Karamoja, delivering an additional 5,845 km of fibre across 63 districts; date not given, after loan effectiveness on 2024-09-18.
facts.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure Phase V

facts.fact: Phase V extends the fibre backbone to districts and sub-counties not reached by Phases I-III (2006-2013) and Phase IV (2018); the Finance Ministry's 2023-11-27 proposal said Phase V would take backbone coverage to 83%.

systems.system: National Data Transmission Backbone Infrastructure Phase V
